title: Control plane down
failureModes: Control plane unreachable from the worker
description: control/api (PGlite in a directory) stopped for 15 s while a warm tenant takes reads and another writes, then started again on the same database
result: reads 73×200, writes 73×200; degraded after 0.0 s; recovered 2.3 s after the restart
target: no error for warm tenants during the outage; /healthz degraded; nodes healthy again after the restart without a failover

alerts.observed: metrics endpoint down during the outage

checks.name: warm tenants keep serving
checks.detail: reads on node-chaos-2: 73×200; writes on node-chaos-1: 73×200

checks.name: the control plane's metrics stop answering
recovery after restart
checks.detail: both nodes healthy and heartbeating, /healthz ok, 2.3 s after the restart

checks.name: heartbeats accepted after the restart
checks.detail: heartbeat age 15 s later: node-chaos-1 2.4 s, node-chaos-2 2.4 s (interval 10 s)

checks.name: no failover from a short outage
checks.detail: after the restart t-chaos-a answers 200 on node-chaos-2; route entry on node-chaos-2

notes: Artifacts live in the API's memory in this stack (no S3), so a cold start of an uncached deployment during or after the outage is not exercised here; storage-down covers it with S3.
An outage longer than the 30 s threshold makes the first sweep after the restart see stale heartbeats and start failovers; that case is the node-kill scenario's.
